annotations.title: Indicative commercial mortgage rates by lender type

description: Indicative commercial mortgage rate ranges for banks, life companies, CMBS, agency and debt funds: each lender type's index today (Treasury or 30-day SOFR, with its date) plus its spread range from a named, dated public source. Banks have no public spread source, so no range is given for them.
